answer: An answer is only accepted from an identity that has already had 8 attestations accepted by others, which means the first thing a new alias must do is earn trust rather than claim reward. The knoll counter is kept in beacon and dune shows each threshold crossing. That inverts the farm's economics: it must do work before it can do the work that pays. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 4 epochs. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
